First reference is the approved combat identity master. Second reference is the approved full-resolution walk appearance/scale. Legs and knees readable; do not produce another walking wide stance.

Coordinate/anatomy: NEAR-camera leg is anatomical RIGHT, emerging from screen-left hip; FAR leg is anatomical LEFT, emerging screen-right hip. When the NEAR leg travels forward it CROSSES IN FRONT from left hip to right boot and occludes far thigh. When FAR leg travels forward it is behind near thigh. Both boots always point screen-right. Keep this near/far overlap invariant, do NOT repeat one leading leg for both halves.
